The '''1996–97 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 61st season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 6 September 1996 and ended on 25 May 1997. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their 26th Greek title and their first one in ten years.
